lastCompletedStory.title: Convert the cam ship CLI to a phase-signal writer

openQuestions: src/ui/Dashboard.tsx's keybar 's' key (buildDashboardKeybarActions or similar, ~line 106) still sends a literal '/cam-ship' via tmux send-keys directly (not through runShip). This is intentionally OUT OF SCOPE for US-005 (not in the story's notes: Files list), but it means the dashboard keybar and `cam ship` (CLI) now trigger the ship phase via two different mechanisms (raw send-keys of a slash command vs the phase:shipping state-file write). If a future story wants a single dispatch path, Dashboard.tsx's 's' key should be rewired to write phase:shipping too (or shell out to `cam ship`), consistent with how the other keybar keys route.

cam-ship.md (the slash-command prompt injected by the OLD send-keys path) is now dead for the CLI path (US-005 removed the '/cam-ship' send-keys call from ship.ts) but is still the literal text sent by Dashboard.tsx's keybar AND presumably still exists as a full agent prompt file. US-006 (next priority, 'Reduce cam-ship.md to a thin phase-signal and record the ADR') is exactly the follow-up that addresses this: thin the prompt and write the ADR recording the phase-signal architecture decision (CLEAN trigger determinism, CAM-149's overall shift from LLM-interpreted slash commands to sidecar-detected state-file phases for both plan and ship).
nextStoryContext: US-006 (priority 6, the last story in this PRD) reduces .claude/commands/cam-ship.md + templates/commands/cam-ship.md to a thin phase-signal stub and records an ADR documenting the phase-signal architecture (CAM-149's shift: cam plan/cam ship no longer inject slash commands via send-keys; they write phase:planning/phase:shipping to .claude/cam-loop.local.md and the sidecar's deterministic loop -- runPlanPhaseFn/runShipPhaseFn in loop.ts -- picks up the phase and runs the pipeline without LLM interpretation). Precedent for the 'thin the prompt' half: check how cam-plan.md was (or wasn't) thinned in the CAM-151 PRD (search git log / templates/commands/cam-plan.md) for a prior-art shape. The ADR should live in docs/adr/ per the Domain Model Convention (only write one if it passes the three gates: hard to reverse, surprising without context, genuine trade-off -- this one plausibly qualifies since the send-keys->state-file shift is a real architectural pivot away from LLM-driven triggering). Remember docs/adr/ is created lazily (do not pre-create an empty directory if this is the first ADR in the repo -- check with `ls docs/adr/` first). Also worth grep'ing the codebase for any other remaining '/cam-ship' or '/cam-plan' string literals that might need cleanup or are intentionally out of scope (see openQuestions: Dashboard.tsx keybar still sends '/cam-ship' directly and was left untouched by both US-004 and US-005 since it is not in either story's Files: notes).

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-005 is a pure internal CLI refactor: ship.ts's imports are node:fs/node:path/node:process (Node built-ins, not a versioned external library surface) plus internal project modules (../tmux/session.ts, ../tmux/bootstrap-wait.ts, ./status.ts, ./next.ts). The behavioral change (replacing a tmux send-keys call with a state-file write) reuses the already-doc-validated renderStateFile/writeStateFile/parseStateFile utilities from next.ts/status.ts (validated in prior CAM-151 stories) and the already-shipped runShipPhase pipeline (US-002/US-003/US-004 of this PRD). No new external library was introduced or exercised.
